results.title: Commentary: Derecho recovery continues, so should preparation
results.description: The Minnesota Department of Commerce met many families who shared their stories. In our community meetings, one theme came up repeatedly: frustration that people weren’t as covered by their insurance as they expected.

results.title: Trump's boat strikes are illegal. Does it matter? (Jeffrey Stein/The Hill)
results.description: Jeffrey Stein / The Hill : Trump's boat strikes are illegal. Does it matter? — On Oct. 12 of last year, Chad Joseph and Rishi Samaroo boarded a small boat docked just beyond a Venezuelan beach. The two Trinidadian men had recently fished together and picked up work as farm hands in Venezuela, but it was time for them to get back to Trinidad.
